standard.summary: 仅用于 Loss 加权退火余弦。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Used by the loss-weighted annealed cosine only.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 仅用于 Loss 加权退火余弦。训练进度带来的 loss 权重达到该值后，loss 下降才允许锁住当前余弦值。默认 0.7。

advanced_en.principle: Only for the loss-weighted annealing cosine. Once the progress-driven loss weight reaches this value, the current cosine value may be locked in as loss declines. Default 0.7.
